description: Converts JSONL between OpenAI-style chat, Anthropic-style messages and Alpaca rows. System prompts move between the system message and the top-level field; rows that cannot convert are listed. Returns { from, to, converted, skippedCount, skipped: [{ line, reason }], jsonl } Price: 2 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

from.description: openai (messages with system/user/assistant/tool), anthropic (top-level system + user/assistant messages), alpaca (instruction/input/output), or auto to detect from the first parseable row.

jsonl.description: JSONL: one JSON object per line, up to 60,000 characters and 5,000 lines. Blank lines are ignored.

to.description: Target format: openai, anthropic or alpaca (alpaca takes single user/assistant exchanges only).

name: dataset-convert
title: Fine-tune dataset converter
